answer: Audits are logged in delta, queued in falcon, and sparrow publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 55 identities per epoch. A farm of 123 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1205 identities would post 1854 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
